nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 傍晚，Marcus 约你在布鲁克林大桥下碰头。他说，今晚要教你『用耳朵拍照』。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Yo! Right on time. Tonight's mission: we ride the subway and shoot the city that nobody looks at.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Everybody photographs the skyline. Boring. The real New York? It's down in the tunnels, man.

options.text: 「What am I looking for?」（我该找什么？）

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Faces. Moments. A tired nurse, a kid asleep on a violin case. The city's whole heart rides the train.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Grimy is honest. Clean is a postcard. I don't shoot postcards, I shoot people. Come on.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 地铁进站，一阵热风扑面。车厢里，一个老人正拉着手风琴，琴声盖过了铁轨的轰鸣。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: See him? Don't just grab the shot. Nod first. Ask with your eyes. Respect gets you the real photo.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 老人朝你们点了点头，继续演奏。Marcus 单膝跪地，快门轻响。你也举起手机，屏住呼吸。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Ohhh, look at you! You waited for the tunnel light to hit his face. That's a photographer's instinct.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Ha, trigger-happy! It's alright - sometimes the messy shot's got more life than the perfect one.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 手风琴老人下车时，冲你们竖了个大拇指。Marcus 翻看着刚拍的照片，忽然安静了下来。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: This one. Right here. That's the shot. You feel that? That's the city letting you in.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: My grandma used to say New York doesn't hug you. It just... makes room. Little by little.

options.text: 「I think it's making room for me.」

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Yeah? Good. Hold onto that feeling. That's the day this place stops being a stranger.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: She was the wisest. Half my photos are just me trying to see the way she did. Come on, one more stop.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们坐过了站，又坐回来，聊着聊着，窗外的灯光一盏盏亮起，像散落在黑夜里的句子。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 走出地铁站，夜色下的纽约灯火通明。你手机里，那张手风琴老人的照片，成了你在这座城市的第一个故事。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】跟着 Marcus，你开始学会用另一种眼光看这座城市。
